title: One message box in team rooms and DMs suggests @people and #Plans, to-dos, events, deals and contacts, and a tag notifies

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-24: rooms, DMs, Plan comments and comms each use a plain textarea; none reads @ or # and room messages send no notification at all. Fix: one shared composer and lib/mentions extractReferences used by every send path, writing the LIVE-2524 mentions table; # suggests items in the author's Space only, through an RLS-guarded lookup; an item shows a 'mentioned in' backlink.

DONE 2026-11-24: one picker (components/mentions/use-tag-picker.tsx) serves the Plan comment box, room composer and DM composer: @ lists the people who can read the conversation, # (two letters) lists Plans, to-dos, events, deals and contacts from searchTaggableItems on the member's own session. Room sends keep only tags on room members, store every tag in public.mentions and send item.mention (bell opens the room); DM sends store # links. The room and DM pickers load on demand, so the chat dock on every page carries none of it. Messages render tags as chips.
